secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials). Optional for booting; without it the Google sign-in button is not shown.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for the same OAuth client. Optional for booting; required for Google sign-in to work.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Microsoft Entra ID application (client) ID (Entra admin center → App registrations → Overview). Optional for booting; without it the Outlook sign-in button is not shown.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Microsoft Entra ID client secret value (Certificates & secrets → New client secret). Optional for booting; required for Outlook sign-in to work.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
secrets.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (Directory ID); defaults to 'common' (any work/school account) when unset.
